last.verdict: Moderna swung to a quarterly profit and raised its revenue outlook on overseas COVID sales, but the profit is seasonal and the bigger cash outlook is mostly borrowing.

takeaways.label: Seasonal profit, higher outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 29% to $1.3B, mainly overseas COVID deliveries, and net income was $162M. Full-year growth is now seen at 15–25%, up from up to 10%. Nine-month loss is still $2.0B.

takeaways.label: Cash jump is mostly debt
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–8.3B, up from $4.7–5.2B, largely because of $2.6B net from convertible notes. Most Q3 sales were still uncollected.

takeaways.label: Cancer vaccine data
takeaways.text: Intismeran plus Keytruda cut melanoma recurrence or death risk by 42% in Phase 3. Moderna and Merck are preparing filings. Further readouts and rare-disease data are due.

takeaways.label: Flu launch limited
takeaways.text: The flu shot mFLUSIVA won U.S. approval, but approval came after the annual contracting cycle, so this season's launch is limited. Moderna still awaits FDA guidance on refiling its flu/COVID combination shot.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
